title: Flat module pullback is exact and direct image preserves injectives
statement: Let $h:T\to Z$ be a flat morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], [def-weil-flat-morphism]. On the categories of Zariski sheaves of modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], the pullback $h^*:\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal O_Z)\to\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal O_T)$ of [def-pc-module-pullback] is exact. The right adjoint $h_*$ carries every injective $\mathcal O_T$-module [def-sp-injective-resolutions] to an injective $\mathcal O_Z$-module.

proof.text: For an exact short complex S of module sheaves on Y, apply clause (5) of [lem-weil-pbc-module-stalk-exact] to obtain exactness of S at the stalk h(x). The natural functor isomorphism of [lem-weil-pbc-module-stalk-pullback] identifies the stalk of tensorPullback h applied to S with the extension of scalars of this stalk complex along h.stalkMap x. In Lean this identification is S.mapNatIso e; its naturality supplies both commuting squares, so no additional compatibility lemma is needed.

proof.text: By [def-weil-flat-morphism], Flat.iff_flat_stalkMap makes (h.stalkMap x).hom flat. The flat tensor exactness of [lem-weil-pbc-flat-tensor-exact] is used in its extension-of-scalars categorical form, Mathlib ModuleCat.preservesFiniteLimits_extendScalars_of_flat. Extension of scalars is a left adjoint, hence also preserves finite colimits and zero morphisms. ShortComplex.Exact.map therefore sends the exact stalk complex to an exact tensor complex. Transport exactness through the natural isomorphism from step 1 using ShortComplex.exact_of_iso. Clause (5) of [lem-weil-pbc-module-stalk-exact] now detects exactness of the pulled-back sheaf complex.

proof.text: The adjunction in [def-pc-module-pullback], as nonempty_tensorPullbackAdjunction, gives tensorPullback h a left-adjoint instance and therefore preservation of finite colimits. Module pushforward is additive, so Adjunction.left_adjoint_additive makes tensorPullback h additive. Steps 1 and 2 show that it preserves every exact short complex. Functor.preservesHomology_of_map_exact and Functor.preservesFiniteLimits_of_preservesHomology yield preservation of finite limits. Finally, Functor.preservesInjectiveObjects_of_adjunction_of_preservesMonomorphisms applies the adjunction and the resulting monomorphism preservation: this is the extension argument for injective objects of [def-sp-injective-resolutions], with adjunction naturality supplied by Mathlib.
